title: Static VS Video Ads: Which perform better?
description: Static VS Video Ads: Which perform better?
transcript: Video or static ads perform better on meta. I think it depends on the quality. So the best quality video ads normally outperform statics, but a mediocre static will outperform a mediocre video ads. So I have to recommend the beginners start with statics, imagery, carousels, things like that. And as you become more advanced and want to experiment and level up, add in video to the mix. That's probably going to be your best long term option.
